item.title: ONLY ON 8: Political Analyst Steve Flowers talks about Trump endorsement in Lt. Gov. race
item.description: Action 8 Political Analyst Steve Flowers reveals whether he believes President Trump's endorsement in the lieutenant governor's race could shake up the field.

item.title: Fourth-grade students at Montgomery Academy celebrate Mardi Gras
item.description: Some fourth-grade students are celebrating Mardi Gras at school as they learn about Alabama history.

item.title: EJI Founder Bryan Stevenson remembers legacy of Rev. Jesse Jackson
item.description: Bryan Stevenson, the founder of the Montgomery-based Equal Justice Initiative, is remembering the life and work of Rev. Jesse Jackson.

item.title: Alabama Kidney Foundation to kick off annual Kidney Walk & Celebration
item.description: The 2026 kickoff will take place on Friday, February 20 from 11:30 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. at the RSA Activity Center on Dexter Avenue.

item.title: The Warming Continues For Now
item.description: 80 degree warmth is possible later this week.

item.title: City of Prattville to hold 25th annual Black History Program
item.description: This year's event will take place on Friday, February 27 at 6:00 p.m. at the Doster Memorial Community Center.

item.title: Cloverdale Playhouse to feature “American Son”
item.description: The play starts February 19 and runs through March 1.

item.title: Montgomery nonprofit to hold annual fundraiser benefiting survivors of violence, sexual assault
item.description: This year's event will take place on Friday, February 20 at 6:00 p.m. at The Whippoorwill Venue in Matthews.

item.title: Auburn standout Keyshawn Hall could return at Mississippi State after benching
item.description: The Tiger's leading scorer is expected to be back out on the court for Auburn's upcoming matchup at Mississippi State. Hall missed Auburn's previous game against No. 20 Arkansas.

item.title: Braves give veteran Dominic Smith non-roster invite to major league camp
item.description: The Atlanta Braves have added veteran first baseman and outfielder Dominic Smith to their major league spring training camp as a non-roster invitee.
